recipes.label: Speak to Poppy Lascelles

slots.label: Consent
slots.description: Add Passion to accept, or Reason to interrogate Poppy further.

recipes.startdescription: 'My dear, I've been wanting to talk to you. Sometimes, I fund scholars of the invisible arts. I'd like to offer you my support. A substantial contribution. And all you need to do, some day, is to introduce me to someone else who'll end matters properly.' She smiles, benignly. [Add Passion to accept, or Reason to interrogate her further.]
recipes.description: I didn't take up Poppy's offer.

recipes.label: Speak to Poppy Lascelles

slots.label: Consent
slots.description: Add Passion to accept, or Reason to interrogate Poppy further.

recipes.startdescription: Her offer is too good to be true. You immediately accept Poppy's offer without inquiring more. Certainly this will not lead to a negative outcome.

recipes.label: Accept Poppy's Offer
recipes.startdescription: 'Yes, that's exactly right. I'll come back tonight.'
recipes.description: A tiny packet of tiny treasures: a gift from Poppy. She'll see me again in the Season of Rags, for me to make the introduction I promised.

recipes.label: Question Poppy closely
recipes.description: 'Yes. When the Season of Rags comes round again, my sponsor will require someone for an ending. You can provide someone sufficiently loyal, or you can provide yourself. As you prefer. I don't want to be any trouble.'

recipes.label: A researcher
recipes.startdescription: Poppy connected me with a researcher. I hope they can help me.
recipes.description: The researcher is eager to help you.
recipes.comments: This leads to marking the person as a collaborator with the hand who will betray and try to kill you if you leave the hand. You only get hand leniency as a bright young thing.

recipes.label: A researcher
recipes.startdescription: I hired a researcher. I hope they can help me.
recipes.description: The researcher is eager to help you.

recipes.label: Poppy's Request
recipes.startdescription: In the 'Season of Rags', Poppy will return...

recipes.label: Silence from Poppy
recipes.startdescription: Poppy is seen around town, assisting at charitable events, smiling benignly.

recipes.label: A Friendly Visit from Poppy
recipes.startdescription: 'This is the time, my dear. The Sun-in-Rags requires his conclusion. Will it be you? Or do you have a friend?'

recipes.label: A Suitable Conclusion
recipes.startdescription: 'What a loyal friend you have here! Do say goodbye, now.'
recipes.description: My follower is gone. I remain. Poppy Lascelles is seen, here and there. She may have more to say to me.
